2026-03-01: Intro call (Ava + Diego) with CTO Lauren Kim, frontend lead Mateo, backend Rani. Fast-paced startup, product-market fit in SMB verticals.
They build an in-app assistant embedded in their web product (React). Primary focus = typing UX with streaming responses and low perceived latency.
Reqs: p95 token response < 300ms for common short queries, end-to-end (client→Redwood→client streaming). Target concurrency ~40-80 qps during peak.
Cost sensitivity: tight. Want hostable hosted_api with per-token pricing; will test batch vs streaming cost differences. Estimated initial monthly usage ~5M tokens.
Model prefs: open models preferred for cost control; willing to evaluate Redwood-verified LLM variants. Need easy model swap for fallbacks.
Security: initial production on public cloud (us-west-2). SOC2 expected within 6 months; SSO later in roadmap. Require audit logging for developer events.
POC ask: provide a short streaming SDK example (React + WebSocket or EventSource) and sample latency traces. Also want a small perf benchmark on us-west-2 for 512-token chat flows.
Quote from Lauren: 'We need the assistant to feel instantaneous — typing indicator + word-by-word streaming; anything over 300ms feels sluggish.'

Technical notes: backend currently proxies requests through a small Go service. They prefer REST+Server-Sent-Events but open to websockets. Plan: simple 2-week POC integration, then ramp to limited beta.
Next meeting tentative: 2026-03-16 tech sync (mateo + diego) to walk through streaming example and sample logs.
